Online Multiplayer Matchmaking Engine

Problem Statement
An online multiplayer gaming platform needs to match players based on their skill ratings.

Each player has a skill value.

Matching Rules:
1. Two players can form a match only if
|skill1 − skill2| ≤ K
2. Each player can play only once.
3. You must maximize the total number of matches.

Your task is to determine the maximum number of matches possible.

Input Format
First line contains:
n k

Second line contains:
n integers representing skill ratings.

Output Format
Print the maximum number of matches.
